Topic 13.5: Writing 13.5.1 Creative Narrative Composition: Idioms
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 13.5.1 Creative Narrative Composition: Idioms, part of Strand 13 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8 ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: What makes a story outstanding? 2. How can we improve our writing skills?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. explain the meaning of the specified idioms in context,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Writing 13.5.1 Creative Narrative Composition: Idioms in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. compose a narrative composition using the specified idioms,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Writing 13.5.1 Creative Narrative Composition: Idioms in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 13.5.1 Creative Narrative Composition: Idioms together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Collaboration is enhanced as the learner reflects on progress made as they share their compositions.

• Digital Literacy is achieved as learner interacts with technology when confirming online the meaning of the specified idioms.

Values:
Respect is fostered as the learner listens to peers ́ opinions and views about their compositions.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Effective Communication is achieved as the learner expresses their ideas creatively in narrative composition.

2. compose a narrative composition using the specified idioms,
